features.name: Javelin is a spear made for throwing; harpoon is spear-like with a barbed head for spear fishing/hunting
Modern versions may use plastics/metal alloys; traditional versions a wooden shaft and bone/stone head
Both alternatives share one catalog row, but barbs are required for the harpoon interpretation, not universally for javelin

Actual conditioned overlay and original pair reviewed: matched framing/proportions; complete shaft, head and barb gaps retained. Shallow grooves accepted. Arsenal printed19/PDF21 and printed173/PDF175: this combined Harpoon/Javelin row explicitly selects the barbed harpoon alternative. Long shaft and barbed head meet the prose; not every javelin has barbs. Exact proportions, materials/finish, colors and grip treatment are artistic interpretation; no own labeled harpoon illustration claimed.
